promptSummary: Create a seamless 16:9 horror-dungeon exploration interface background. Reserve the upper 40 percent for a moody gothic ruined castle scene with dark blue-gray fog and safe negative space for HUD cards. Make the lower 60 percent a dark gunmetal route-planning board with restrained grid, contour markings, riveted mechanical framing and a clear horizontal division. Cold-steel military archive style, readable low contrast, no parchment, no wax seal, no text, no icons, no route nodes, no buttons, no logos, no watermark.
selectionNotes: The selected second iteration corrected the composition boundary to approximately 40/60. The earlier 60/40 candidate was discarded and not retained in runtime assets.
